items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: When Martina took it over, instead of him building it up he tore it up.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well he classified the men which he would benefit the musicians more than anybody they had there if they'd let him see it there. But they felt like he wasn't doing it the way they wanted and they got rid of Gilbert and they got old man Martina. And that broke up all his ideas was. His ideas was to get so many men together that couldn't play that much and let somebody go over and teach them and rate them on like that. And the men that was qualified could read pretty good, you know, it would be a band up with…
So he didn't give him a chance to learn.
